scope: Bounded factual follow-up on newer Federal District presidential runoff polling. No market prices, forecast or recommendation.
frozen_metric: Flávio Bolsonaro vs. Lula by most valid votes in the 2026-10-25 presidential runoff in the Federal District; this is local, not national or governor race.

newer_poll_fact.pollster: Quaest; commissioned by Globo/TV Globo according to outlet reports.
newer_poll_fact.geography: Federal District; 1,104 voters age 16+ reported by multiple outlets.
newer_poll_fact.question_description: Stimulated second-round voting intention; respondents shown candidate names.
newer_poll_fact.valid_vote_normalization: 50/(50+40)=55.56% and 40/(50+40)=44.44%, approximately 56/44. This is an arithmetic normalization of the reported 50/40 and matches the Reddit title 44/56; it is not a separate poll or additional measurement.
